entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
This is completely unacceptable! I bought a pair of your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes a couple of months ago and they are complete garbage. I want my money back immediately!

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's an issue of them being terrible! I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but it doesn't matter. Every single time I ride, I get painful blisters on my heels. They're unwearable! I need a refund, and I'm not taking no for an answer.

I can definitely understand your frustration; getting blisters from new gear is the last thing anyone wants. That's not the experience we aim for at VeloFit. Let me just pull up your order details to check on the return options. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?

Look, stop stalling! Just process the return. It's not that complicated. If you can't do it, put me on the phone with a manager who can. I'm about to leave a review about this on every website I can find.

I understand you're upset, and there's no need to speak with a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you right now. I've just located your order. I can see you purchased the Mountain Bike Shoes 77 days ago. Our policy for our standard gear like these cycling shoes is a 90-day return window.
So? What does that mean? Are you giving me my money back or not?
It means you are well within the timeframe for a return. I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you. I am processing that now.
Oh. For real? You'll actually take them back for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it at any designated shipping location. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Well... fine. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
